areas.title: Areas
areas.description: Suburbs or towns to search on Google Maps, one per line. Each area is a separate Google Maps search.

areaSuffix.title: Area suffix
areaSuffix.description: Added after each area name for the Google Maps location, e.g. 'Durbanville, South Africa'.

searchTerms.title: Google Maps search terms
searchTerms.description: What to search for in each area. Each term is a separate search, so more terms means more places (and cost).

maxPlacesPerSearch.title: Max places per search term per area
maxPlacesPerSearch.description: Google Maps places to collect for each search term in each area.

extraFacebookPages.title: Extra Facebook pages
extraFacebookPages.description: Venue Facebook page URLs to always include, e.g. pages Google Maps misses. One per line.

venueRefreshDays.title: Re-discover venues every (days)
venueRefreshDays.description: The Google Maps venue list is cached and reused for this many days, so weekly runs only pay for Facebook posts. Set 0 to search Google Maps on every run.

postsPerPage.title: Posts per Facebook page
postsPerPage.description: Maximum recent posts to read from each venue's page.

daysBack.title: Only posts from the last (days)
daysBack.description: Ignore posts older than this. Old posts are filtered out by the Facebook scraper, so you don't pay for them.

geminiApiKey.title: Gemini API key
geminiApiKey.description: Your Google AI Studio API key (aistudio.google.com/apikey). Stored encrypted. Leave empty to use the Actor's secret GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable instead. Without any key the Actor falls back to a simple keyword filter.

geminiModel.title: Gemini model
geminiModel.description: Model ID used to read posts and their photos.

geminiRequestsPerMinute.title: Gemini requests per minute
geminiRequestsPerMinute.description: One request per venue. Keep this under your free-tier limit.

maxImagesPerVenue.title: Max photos sent to Gemini per venue
maxImagesPerVenue.description: Many specials are only on the poster photo. The first photo of each post is sent, up to this many per venue.

mapsMaxCostUsd.title: Max Google Maps cost per run (USD)
mapsMaxCostUsd.description: Hard cap on what the Google Maps scraper can charge in one run, split across the areas. Only used when venues are re-discovered.

facebookMaxCostUsd.title: Max Facebook posts cost per run (USD)
facebookMaxCostUsd.description: Hard cap on what the Facebook posts scraper can charge in one run.
